text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Rob Roy. There... you are.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Here. The requested items... Materials compiling... American... training theory.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
And... resistance bands for training.
American-made... my personal favorite.
...Ordered them.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! You went through all that trouble for me...?! 
Ah, ...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Are you... training after this?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Eh? Y-Yes! 
My library committee duties are just about finished, so soon...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
I will... conduct your training.
...Testing the contents... of the materials.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Eh! A-Are you sure...?! 
I would be honored!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Okay. Next, ease up the pace!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...10 sets complete.
Good.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
In American races...
speed endurance... is decisive.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Your primary battlefield... is medium to long distance, but...
building speed... will not hurt.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
The interval training... we just did.
You should... utilize it too.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Yes!
Thank you so much...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
...Cool down.
I made protein too. Wait here.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ...!
...I'm truly learning so much...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...B-But when I think about it,
is having her do all this for me... leaning on her too much...?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Just because I offhandedly said I was interested in American racing...
did I end up making her waste an enormous amount of effort...?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ............What is wrong?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Ah, u-um, well...!
I'm so sorry, Kris S-san, for making you go to such great lengths for my sake...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: The materials alone were trouble enough, and yet I indulged myself in your training too...!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...Don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...You are... my junior.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: So――don't worry about it.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes... umm...? 
Ah, well, that is...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
T-The pleasure is mine! Having Kris S-san as my senior makes me 
so happy... wait, not quite, well it is true, 
but umm, err...!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*pat*)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: ――Hyaah!?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
! ――Sorry.
...For some reason――my hand moved on its own.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Eek, no, it's fine! 
Umm, I was just surprised, 
not that I disliked it at all! So, umm...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Umm, Kris S-san...?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
――No.
...The protein. ――I will teach you the recipe too.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes, gladly!
... !

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One evening, witnessing this heartwarming exchange 
between senior and junior by chance 
left me feeling completely soothed.
